As [previously posted on KotakuInAction](https://www.reddit.com/r/KotakuInAction/comments/4ohbka/happenings_natsucon_in_saint_louis_has_approved/), my #GamerGate panel at Natsucon in Saint Louis is just a couple of days away! The panel will be held on Saturday at 10PM CST and while it's not a prime-time slot, Natsu is much larger than Arch Anime, so we're hoping for a bigger audience than [my last GamerGate panel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CL4sJyEkZOE). The convention center is about a half hour from downtown Saint Louis and four hours from Chicago. Tickets are available at the door with weekend passes being $45 and single-day Saturday passes being $30; military personell receive a discounted rate.

We'll be covering a number of topics surrounding the consumer revolt, from it's history to the various positions both sides take on the various issues. From censorship to ethics to the representation of women in games to allegations of harassment and beyond, we intend to cover a lot of ground and encourage a productive discussion. I'll be the panel lead, but one of my more GamerGate-neutral leaning friends will be assisting me in setting up the panel and helping ensure that the panel covers both sides in a relatively fair manner.

I should note that social justice warriors have [tried to get the panel canceled](https://www.reddit.com/r/KotakuInAction/comments/4p699g/censorship_sjws_pressure_natsucon_to_censor_my/) and it's possible they will attempt to disrupt the panel with bomb threats, pulling a fire alarm or an in-person "protest" (shouting down anyone they dissagree with). In addition, please note that the panel will be recorded, with the consent of the audience.

Several GamerGate people have either contacted me or posted in the previous threads about attending and that's great! At my Arch Anime panel we had a mini-meetup at the convention and grabbed a few beers. Given how late our Natsucon panel is, it might be prudent to have the meetup before the panel this time around. If anyone wants to meet up and check out a few panels or grab a few beers prior to the convention, contact me on Reddit or Twitter ([@netscape9](https://twitter.com/netscape9)), as I'll be coordinating any such meetups.
